headline: 英國劇場與書市藝文一週
context: 英國萊斯特 Curve 劇院把電影《沉默的羔羊》搬上舞台，被劇評形容「既震撼又讓人反胃」。諾貝爾經濟學獎得主艾塞默魯（Daron Acemoglu）的新書《自由民主怎麼了？》，把矛頭指向不再回應民眾需求的菁英階層。愛丁堡藝穗節上，諷刺劇《Target Audience》則從調侃電視產業，一路演成一部談權力的政治劇。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Curve, Leicester There are electrifying – and also queasy – moments in this version of the classic 90s horror about the interrogation of a psychotic psychiatrist by an FBI rookie Soon after the hostile reception of the theatrical version of Trainspotting , another landmark 1990s movie, The Silence of the Lambs, attempts a similar manoeuvre. In this case, director Nikolai Foster is surely sensible not to turn this source material into a musical. And adapter Gina Gionfriddo is working not from Jonathan Demme’s film but Thomas Harris’s 1988 novel about the dangerous interrogation of psychotic psychiatrist Dr Hannibal Lecter by FBI rookie Clarice Starling for his insight into serial killer Buffalo Bill. The biggest risk of theatricalised movies is that the acting becomes a form of karaoke. Mollie Gallagher, making a confident stage debut in effectively the lead role, echoes Jodie Foster’s Virginia accent and ramps up the pugnacious posture and walk. John Partridge’s Lecter, who is more sonically American than Hopkins’ variation on his Welsh register (the character is actually Lithuanian), avoids the hissy lip-sipping and also injects less charm and culture. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The Nobel-winning economist takes aim at elites for no longer meeting the needs of the masses In 2009, the tech billionaire Peter Thiel published an essay with the portentous title The Education of a Libertarian, in which he announced: “I no longer believe that freedom and democracy are compatible.” Since the 1920s, he wrote, “the vast increase in welfare beneficiaries and the extension of the franchise to women” had rendered the notion of “capitalist democracy” an oxymoron. To be fair, Thiel still seems happy to exercise his freedom to extract money from democracies, via his co-founding of Palantir , which was lately given lots of money by the NHS. Thiel calls himself, as many such do, a “classical liberal”, but Daron Acemoglu argues that his ilk still has much in common with left-liberals. All of them, he writes, agree on “the desirability of basic individual rights and freedoms (including the right not to be coerced and the freedoms of expression, religion, association, and choice); constraints on power, especially political power; and broad protections for equality before the law”. On his telling, by the mid-20th century democracy with liberal characteristics had amply proved its worth: blue-collar labour was generously rewarded, and there was a sense of “shared prosperity”. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh With characteristic wit, Dan Bishop’s comedy develops from a jolly send-up of the vacuous TV industry into a politically astute play about power ‘I’ve never read anything Greek, but I bet if feels exactly like this,” says Isabelle (RhéAna Kamalu) at the apocalyptic height of this zingy comedy. She is a gen Z intern whose end-of-times neuroses have suddenly become justified after she receives a government alert to stay indoors. Maybe she did not want to die young, after all. The line has the characteristic wit of playwright Dan Bishop, author of last year’s Brainsluts , but the scene itself is unexpected. Wind back to the start of Target Audience and you will find something much more ephemeral. At Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh , until 30 August All our Edinburgh festival reviews Continue reading...

英國劇場與書市藝文一週

英國萊斯特 Curve 劇院把電影《沉默的羔羊》搬上舞台，劇評形容這齣戲「既震撼又讓人反胃」。書市這邊，諾貝爾經濟學獎得主艾塞默魯（Daron Acemoglu）出版新書《自由民主怎麼了？》，矛頭指向不再回應民眾需求的菁英階層。愛丁堡藝穗節上，諷刺劇《Target Audience》則從調侃電視產業，一路演成一部談權力的政治劇。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 7 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

英國劇場與書市藝文一週

萊斯特 Curve 劇院把電影《沉默的羔羊》搬上舞台，劇評形容整齣戲「既震撼又讓人反胃」。書市這邊，諾貝爾經濟學獎得主艾塞默魯（Daron Acemoglu）出版新書《自由民主怎麼了？》，把矛頭指向不再回應民眾需求的菁英階層。愛丁堡藝穗節上，諷刺劇《Target Audience》則從調侃電視產業出發，一路演成一部談權力的政治劇。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 7 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 英國的劇場跟書市，這幾天話題不少。萊斯特有劇院把電影《沉默的羔羊》搬上舞台，劇評說整齣戲又震撼又讓人反胃。書市這邊，諾貝爾經濟學獎得主艾塞默魯，出了一本新書談自由民主怎麼了——矛頭指向不再回應民眾需求的菁英階層。愛丁堡藝穗節，還有一齣諷刺劇，從調侃電視產業開始，最後演成一部談權力的政治劇。
